title: OperationCommand
description: Transport binding for a single interop operation. Every cross-agent or cross-tool call MUST be modelled as an OperationCommand that references a DelegatedAuthority envelope and a TrustBoundary. The command cannot be dispatched without a valid, unexpired envelope. Audit events (LedgerEvent) are emitted for every command regardless of outcome.

command_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this command instance.

operation.description: Operation type; determines transport semantics and required LedgerEvent type.

authority_envelope_id.description: Reference to the DelegatedAuthority envelope that authorises this command.

trust_boundary_id.description: Reference to the TrustBoundary scoping this command.

transport.description: Wire transport for this command: 'mcp' for tool invocations, 'a2a' for agent-to-agent calls, 'internal' for grant lifecycle and diagnostic operations.

target.description: Transport-specific target descriptor. Contents vary by operation type.

grant_id.description: Grant identifier being checked or revoked (tool_grant.validate, tool_grant.revoke).

export_scope.description: Scope filter for the diagnostic export (interop.diagnostics.export_redacted).

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the operation payload; the payload itself is never stored in the command record.

policy_hash.description: Hash of the policy evaluated at command issue time.

ledger_event_type.description: LedgerEvent type that MUST be emitted when this command is executed, regardless of outcome.
